component.name: yt-dlp
component.summary: Download audio and video from the command line

description.p: This unofficial community package downloads the official yt-dlp Linux ZIP unmodified at install time. yt-dlp is a command-line audio and video downloader supporting many websites. Download only content you are permitted to download and follow the relevant service terms.

Run flatpak run io.github.yt_dlp.yt_dlp URL in a terminal. Downloads go to the current directory, as with upstream yt-dlp; use --paths to choose another. The application menu entry opens a terminal that prompts for a media URL and stays open after each download. Press Enter at the empty prompt to close it.

FFmpeg and ffprobe from the runtime support merging and post-processing. A pinned official Deno runtime runs the EJS components bundled with yt-dlp for YouTube support. Remote components are disabled by upstream's default.

Update with flatpak update io.github.yt_dlp.yt_dlp. The official ZIP build disables self-updating; this launcher also passes --no-update and disables Deno update notifications. The -U and --update-to options cannot replace this build. FlatPark automatically tracks new stable yt-dlp releases.

Network access and your home folder are granted; external drives are not (add them with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media io.github.yt_dlp.yt_dlp). Keyrings and host commands are not accessible. Configurations and cache use this app's private XDG directories.

ul.li: Allow saving to Videos: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-videos io.github.yt_dlp.yt_dlp, then select it with --paths.
For exported cookies, put a writable copy in Downloads and pass its path with --cookies. yt-dlp saves cookies back to this file.
Undo these permissions: flatpak override --user --reset io.github.yt_dlp.yt_dlp
